cohort: Women with higher-order multiple (HOM) pregnancies referred to a single quaternary hospital in Australia between 2007 and 2016.
finding: Multi-fetal pregnancy reduction (MFPR) was associated with an increase in gestational age and a reduction in births before 34 weeks, though it also showed a higher likelihood of miscarriage compared to expectant management.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth was the primary outcome, with median gestation 35.3 weeks for MFPR and 33.1 weeks for EM.
